## Notes

**Quick read:** Blonde TikTok Shop affiliate mom ($8.8K GMV in half of July elsewhere) with a 2 to 3 year old daughter and an older son; makes short, sunny POV text videos at the beach, by the car, on her porch and in her kitchen. Original account: 6 of 6 approved, all run as ads, $1,149 GMV, ROAS 1.17.
**Best next move:** send the weekly ideas Fatima promised on Sep 22 ("I will put something together for you then"), and in them retire her "free hands" hook in favour of arm relief.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: blonde mom, hair in a claw clip or bun, often in a pink bikini, a white sundress or a lilac lounge set. Daughter about 2 to 3 (blonde, pink rash guard); an older boy (about 5) walks out of the house in 83688d8a. Settings: beach at low tide, a car in a sunny parking lot, the front porch of a dark green house, a white kitchen, and a living room with a lit Christmas tree (Sep 10). Summery and bright.
- Format: two modes. (1) Text-only POV montages with music, 14 to 23 seconds: "POV: You can hold your stage 3 clinger AND have free hands", "POV: Life just became so much simpler with your stage 3 clinger", "POV: Your toddler loves to be held all the time", "When holding your toddler stopped being a problem and became enjoyable", "Now your mornings can look like THIS with a stage 3 clinger". (2) Voiceover or talking head product pitches: "Ditch the 18-foot long carrier that you have to look at a video to figure out how to use while your baby is screaming", "Calling all moms with stage 3 clingers". She shows the put-on (sling over the head, scoop toddler in), a kiss or cuddle moment, and a sweet beat where her daughter wears the sling with her own baby doll (83688d8a).
- What worked: all 6 approved; 787ba0b4 (Aug 9 kitchen mornings, "Amazing!") ran in 3 ads; the four Aug 12 videos in 2 ads each. 33 purchases, $1,990 purchase value on $1,708 spend. "Stage 3 clinger" is her signature phrase.
- Safety and checklist: seat looks under her daughter's bottom in the wearing shots; toddler legs hang naturally (fine at this size). Issues: the "free hands" claim is burned into a48a2be5's text and spoken in 2b738a91 ("You can now hold your toddler and still have free hands"), both still running in ads. In 787ba0b4 around 21s one arm reaches out wide and the other is not clearly on her daughter. Beach clip 4a410eb9 is filmed wide, so the hand and buckle cannot be checked. The Sep 10 video (0a52a038) is product-only with an inset clip, "I can't believe the price" text and an "on sale" line, filmed in front of a Christmas tree in September.
- Strengths: aspirational outdoor settings, great cuddle moments, short tight edits built for TikTok Shop, a proven comparison hook against long wraps.
- To improve: drop "free hands"; keep one hand visibly on her daughter in every clip; film closer so the buckle and seat read; fewer sale-dependent lines.
